recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic 1960s-era cartoon composition featuring four anthropomorphic animal characters and one human character interacting around a wooden staircase. The style uses flat, saturated color fills with thick black outlines against a textured, mustard-yellow ochre background.
coreVisualRelationships: Characters arranged in a descending diagonal following the staircase line
Contrast between the warm yellow background and cool blue/green character tones
Interaction between the expressive human figure at the bottom and the playful animals above
Integration of hand-lettered display type into the upper right negative space
coreInvariants: Heavy canvas or wood-grain texture overlaying the entire image
Limited color palette of primary red, yellow, blue, and forest green

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Characters are distributed across the left and center-bottom; text occupies the upper right quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, red-outlined title text in the top right acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the staircase from top-left down to the human figure at the bottom-center, then sweeps up to the text on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Large areas of textured ochre provide breathing room for the busy character interactions.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mustard yellow/ochre background providing a warm, vintage base.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Forest green for the staircase and shadows, providing structural depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright primary red and royal blue for character clothing to draw immediate attention.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation for characters against a slightly desaturated, textured background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Sans-serif with varying weights and playful, irregular baselines.
letterConstructionRules: Mixed case with exaggerated height for initial letters
Thick, high-contrast outlines on primary words
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'C' is oversized and acts as a container for the following letters
Lowercase 'i' uses a large circular dot
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A bold, outlined display face paired with a smaller, all-caps secondary sans-serif for credits.

preserve: The red outline on the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the playful, thick-stroke cartoon energy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1960s cartoon illustration of four chipmunks and one man on a staircase. Use flat colors, thick black outlines, and a mustard-yellow textured background. Leave the top right quadrant empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add custom hand-lettered text in the top right. The main title should be white with a thick red outline, featuring a bouncing baseline and rounded, playful letterforms.

verificationChecks: Is the background texture visible through the colors?
Are the outlines thick and consistent?
Is the text placement balanced against the character weight?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the red text outline
mustRedesign: Specific character faces to avoid copyright
Exact wording of the original title
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no modern digital artifacts are present
Check that the staircase perspective aligns with character placement
Verify the color palette remains strictly within the 1960s primary/earth tone range
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1960s flat-color cartoon characters] with [textured ochre background] and [bouncing, outlined hand-lettered display type] arranged in a [diagonal staircase composition].
